'''Colonel Fuhrberger''' is a minor character in [[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]]. He is a retired [[Military|army]] colonel.

==Character history==
Colonel Fuhrberger, at an unknown time, joined the [[United States of America|US]] [[Military|Army]], serving in the Vietnam War, and rose to the position of colonel before retiring. He later moved to [[East Beach]], [[Los Santos in GTA III Era|Los Santos]] where he keeps a large amount of military memorabilia, a fact discovered by [[LB|Alby "LB" Brown]], an associate of [[Grove Street Families]] gangster [[Ryder|Lance "Ryder" Wilson]], who later enlists gang coleader and protagonist [[Carl Johnson|Carl "CJ" Johnson]] to [[Home Invasion|enter his home and steal the crates of hardware]] to help their fight with the [[Ballas]], who Ryder is secretly working for. Fuhrberger, during this time, is asleep in his bedroom although he can be woken up and killed by Johnson.

==Trivia==
*His name is a play on the phrase "fur burger", slang for female genitalia. 
*Colonel Fuhrberger's home remains accessible after the completion of [[Home Invasion]].
